components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strong action for creating, generating, advancing, and exporting.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:0; border-radius:14px; padding:0 14px; background:#ff8a00; color:#3a2109; font:850 14px/1 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 6px 10px rgba(201,93,0,.18); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background 200ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ed7d00; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a84600; outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,138,0,.24); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.55; box-shadow:none; transform:none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A clear alternative action without competing with the orange primary control.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid #efd6b9; border-radius:14px; padding:0 14px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.8); color:#3a2109; font:850 14px/1 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background 200ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#ffb14a; background:#ffe2be; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a84600; outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,138,0,.24); }

components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:7px; color:#3a2109; font:800 14px/1.2 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-textarea { min-height:120px; width:100%; border:1px solid #dfc3a4; border-radius:16px; padding:12px; background:#fffdf9; color:#3a2109; font:400 16px/1.55 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif; resize:vertical; transition:border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color:#866343; opacity:1; } .ds-textarea:hover { border-color:#ffb14a; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #a84600; outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,138,0,.24); }

components.name: Slide Editor Shell
components.description: Dark, compact chrome that surrounds a theme-owned 16:9 slide canvas.
components.css: .ds-editor { display:grid; grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr) 150px; gap:12px; padding:12px; border-radius:18px; background:#302012; color:#fff; font:800 13px/1.2 Nunito,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-editor aside { min-height:160px; border-radius:12px; padding:12px; background:#432b18; } .ds-editor main { display:grid; place-items:center; min-height:160px; border-radius:12px; padding:12px; background:#f5e8d8; } .ds-canvas { display:grid; width:min(100%,420px); aspect-ratio:16/9; place-items:center; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:#3a2109; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(58,33,9,.16); }

narrative.overview: StudyDeck AI is a practical workspace for preparing a presentation under deadline. The light, warm app shell keeps the next action obvious; orange represents action, green confirms trustworthy progress, and purple stays reserved for AI/editor moments. The dark editor shell creates focus while generated slide themes remain independent so web preview and export match.
keyCharacteristics: Workflow-first screens with a visible next action.
Nunito is the single application type family.
Functional accents: orange for action, green for confidence, purple for AI/editor context.
Short, purposeful elevation and no decorative glass-card layers.
Desktop topbar becomes safe-area-aware mobile bottom navigation at 760px.

rules.name: The Task Color Rule
rules.body: Orange, green, and purple communicate action, confirmation, or AI/editor context; they are not decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Ceiling
rules.body: The warm background stays quiet and task-led, never a cream marketing surface.

rules.name: The Russian Label Rule
rules.body: Let long Russian labels wrap or gain space before reducing legibility.

rules.name: The Purposeful Lift Rule
rules.body: Use the existing short shadow vocabulary; stronger elevation is earned by interaction or hierarchy.

dos: Do put the student's next action first.
Do use orange for actions and active progress, green for trustworthy completion.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep app-shell and generated-slide theme contracts separate.
Do test long Russian labels and the 760px mobile transition.
donts: Don't use generic green SaaS styling, childish classroom imagery, decorative AI gradients, or heavy glassmorphism.
Don't hide source quality behind polished slides.
Don't add broad decorative shadows to ordinary controls or surfaces.
Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text, or repeated identical icon-card grids.
Don't use app-shell tokens to redesign the independent slide canvas.
